linear-quadratic-rates-secant.alt: The graph of f(x) = −0.5x² + 4x for 0 ≤ x ≤ 8 and the blue secant line through (1, 3.5) and (5, 7.5), which has slope 1. At x = 2 the secant line gives 4.5 (square) while the graph gives f(2) = 6 (dot): the graph is concave down and lies above the secant line between x = 1 and x = 5.
